# bm25

# `fastmcp.server.transforms.search.bm25`

BM25-based search transform.

## Classes

### `BM25SearchTransform` <sup>[https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/blob/main/fastmcp\_slim/fastmcp/server/transforms/search/bm25.py#L89](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/blob/main/fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/transforms/search/bm25.py#L89)</sup>

Search transform using BM25 Okapi relevance ranking.

Maintains an in-memory index that is lazily rebuilt when the tool
catalog's searchable text changes.
